inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors or 50 lateral feet of overhead transmission conductors are not from Utility Compatible Shade Trees list, or site grading does not meet required clearances from transmission facilities
inputs.question: Are there any trees being planted near the overhead electric lines shown on the western and northern boundaries of the site? What species are being proposed in those areas and how far from the OHE lines?
inputs.regionHint: areas near the overhead electric lines on western and northern boundaries

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence and identification question (are trees being planted, what species), which is a prerequisite check before measuring clearances; the actual distance measurement from OHE lines will follow this feature-discovery step.
